content_sections.heading: Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
Gliders India Limited Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Gliders India Limited has announced vacancies for various managerial positions including Information Technology, Marketing, Finance & Accounts, Supply Chain Management and Administration departments.

content_sections.heading: Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the educational qualification and experience requirements specified for each post. Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or MCA from a recognized University/Institute. Minimum 10 years of post-qualification relevant experience. Age Limit: Not more than 50 years. Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or MCA with minimum 5 years relevant experience. OR Diploma in Engineering (CS/IT) or BCA with minimum 7 years relevant experience. Age Limit: Not more than 50 years. Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from a recognized University/Institute. Minimum 10 years of post-qualification relevant experience in marketing, sales, business development or commercial functions. Experience in defence production or defence marketing will be preferred. Age Limit: Not more than 50 years. Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification from ICAI with valid membership. Minimum 10 years post-qualification experience in finance-related areas. Experience in manufacturing companies will be preferred. Age Limit: Not more than 50 years. Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with minimum 3 years relevant experience. OR Diploma in Engineering with minimum 5 years relevant experience. MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Materials Management or Operations Management will be preferred. Age Limit: Not more than 50 years. Candidate should be retired from Defence Public Sector Undertaking under Ministry of Defence. Should have held E-3 level or above position at the time of retirement. Age Limit: Not more than 65 years.

content_sections.heading: Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026 Contract Period
content_sections.text: The Fixed Term Employment contract will initially be for one year and may be extended for another two years based on performance and functional requirements. The maximum contract period will be three years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Download the application format provided with the notification. Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae containing educational qualification, experience and achievements. Attach self-attested copies of educational certificates and experience documents. Pay the application fee, if applicable. Send the complete application PDF to the prescribed email address before the closing date.

content_sections.heading: Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process may include written examination and interview or interview only as decided by Gliders India Limited. Shortlisting based on qualification and experience Written Test and/or Interview Final Selection

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely contractual in nature. The selected candidate will not be entitled to claim regular employment. Candidates may be required to work on holidays or weekends depending on functional requirements. The selected candidate has to maintain confidentiality of GIL data.

faq.question: Q1. What is Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive for DGM, Senior Manager and Manager posts on Fixed Term Employment basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies are available for various managerial positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 20 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary in Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The annual CTC ranges from Rs. 5.40 lakh to Rs. 14.40 lakh depending on the post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Gliders India Limited Jobs?
faq.answer: The qualification varies according to the post. Engineering degrees, MCA, CA, Diploma and relevant professional experience are required for different positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by post. Most positions have a maximum age limit of 50 years, while Manager Administration has a maximum age limit of 65 years.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Gliders India Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending the completed application form and required documents through email.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for GIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen/Ex-Agniveers are exempted from payment.
